description: This is a Java entity class representing an Order in an e-commerce system, including fields for order details, status, payment, delivery, billing, and relationships to products, totals, and history.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents a customer order in the system, including status, date, total amount, customer info, payment, delivery, billing, and relationships to products, totals, and history.

methods.name: Order
methods.description: Default constructor for the Order class.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the order.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the order.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the order.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the order.

methods.name: getLastModified
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the order was last modified.

methods.name: setLastModified
methods.description: Sets the last modified timestamp.

methods.name: getDatePurchased
methods.description: Returns the date the order was purchased.

methods.name: setDatePurchased
methods.description: Sets the purchase date.

methods.name: getOrderDateFinished
methods.description: Returns the date when the order was finished.

methods.name: setOrderDateFinished
methods.description: Sets the finish date of the order.

methods.name: getCurrencyValue
methods.description: Returns the exchange rate for the currency.

methods.name: setCurrencyValue
methods.description: Sets the exchange rate for the currency.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total amount of the order.

methods.name: setTotal
methods.description: Sets the total amount of the order.

methods.name: getIpAddress
methods.description: Returns the IP address from which the order was placed.

methods.name: setIpAddress
methods.description: Sets the IP address.

methods.name: getPaymentModuleCode
methods.description: Returns the payment module code used for the order.

methods.name: setPaymentModuleCode
methods.description: Sets the payment module code.

methods.name: getShippingModuleCode
methods.description: Returns the shipping module code used.

methods.name: setShippingModuleCode
methods.description: Sets the shipping module code.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the Currency object associated with the order.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency associated with the order.

methods.name: getMerchant
methods.description: Returns the MerchantStore associated with the order.

methods.name: setMerchant
methods.description: Sets the merchant store for the order.

methods.name: getOrderProducts
methods.description: Returns the set of products included in the order.

methods.name: setOrderProducts
methods.description: Sets the products for the order.

methods.name: getOrderTotal
methods.description: Returns the total amounts (e.g., subtotals, taxes) associated with the order.

methods.name: setOrderTotal
methods.description: Sets the total amounts for the order.

methods.name: getOrderHistory
methods.description: Returns the history of status changes for the order.

methods.name: setOrderHistory
methods.description: Sets the order status history.

methods.name: setDelivery
methods.description: Sets delivery details for the order.

methods.name: getDelivery
methods.description: Returns delivery details.

methods.name: setBilling
methods.description: Sets billing details for the order.

methods.name: getBilling
methods.description: Returns billing details.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Returns the customer ID associated with the order.

methods.name: setCustomerId
methods.description: Sets the customer ID.

methods.name: getCustomerEmailAddress
methods.description: Returns the customer's email address.

methods.name: setCustomerEmailAddress
methods.description: Sets the customer's email address.

methods.name: getChannel
methods.description: Returns the channel through which the order was placed.

methods.name: setChannel
methods.description: Sets the order channel.

methods.name: setCreditCard
methods.description: Sets credit card details for the order.

methods.name: getCreditCard
methods.description: Returns credit card details.

methods.name: setPaymentType
methods.description: Sets the payment type.

methods.name: getPaymentType
methods.description: Returns the payment type.

methods.name: getOrderType
methods.description: Returns the type of order.

methods.name: setOrderType
methods.description: Sets the type of order.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the locale settings for the order.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the locale for the order.
